critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/games/score has a subtle logic gap on streak: when streak.last_active_date == yesterday the branch computes current_streak and calls db.update, but when it's neither today nor yesterday (gap), it computes current_streak=1 yet the update_one is guarded inside the same else-branch — verify this executes (it does, but the code shape is easy to misread). Consider refactoring for clarity.
BrainGamePlay.jsx is 760 lines with 11 engines in one file — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting engines into /components/games/*.jsx.
PLAYABLE_ENGINES set in BrainGames.jsx must stay in sync with ENGINES map in BrainGamePlay.jsx — a shared constant module would prevent drift.
